credit_lending_product.label: Credit / lending product
credit_lending_product.value: Purchased portfolios of defaulted consumer receivables, plus debt servicing for consumer and business-to-business accounts.

funding_balance_sheet_model.label: Funding / balance-sheet model
funding_balance_sheet_model.value: Deploys capital to purchase and hold defaulted receivable portfolios for collection. Also services portfolios for third parties.

loan_portfolio_yield.label: Loan portfolio yield
loan_portfolio_yield.value: Portfolio revenue uses the effective interest rate established at purchase for each receivable portfolio.

credit_loss_measure.label: Credit-loss measure
credit_loss_measure.value: Allowance for credit losses reflects revisions to expected future recoveries on purchased receivables.

notes: Securitization and any related retained exposure are unclear.
